_about: Reader-facing pictures for codex.md entries the Codex renders under Things or Beasts and others (not Sayings; a person, place or faction with its own file takes its picture there). Claude-owned. name: the entry's bold name exactly; image: a path under saga/art/ (e.g. codex/thistle.jpg); image_alt: what the picture shows; image_caption (optional) and image_focus (optional, "X% Y%"). The picture may show only what the page has put on the page.

entries.name: Thistle
entries.image_alt: Thistle, a dapple-grey mare, at a gallop across a muddy pasture, mouth open, mane and tail flying, with a split-rail fence, haystacks and a farmhouse under a bright sky behind her.
